label: A ground of a concrete beginning has not wholly ceased before the absence
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, if a concrete individual is absent at a moment s and present at a strictly later moment, then every ground of it is present at s or at some moment strictly after s. It forbids a ground that was present only before s and produced the thing across s. It allows a ground simultaneous with or later than the thing.
